Jake O'Brien has confirmed he will not leave Everton this summer, ending speculation about a possible transfer. The defender stressed he was never close to departing last summer and remains committed to the club’s plans.

O'Brien also disclosed a terrifying medical episode, revealing he was "one day away from falling into a coma" due to his type 1 diabetes. He explained how he manages the condition in the dressing room and on the pitch, and now inspires schoolchildren living with the disease at Finch Farm, highlighting his role as the Premier League’s only diabetic player.
